notes.title: Shops and Items Update
notes.notes:
Content and bugfixes:
Added tons of melee weapons, potions, teleportation scroll and other items to the game
Added shops on spawn and in the red forest
Added chests on the mid river and in the purple forest to gain golds
Added ability to farm gold by last hitting enemies
Quality of life improvements so the game feels much smoother and comfortable to play
Fixed all major bugs
